title: 引力魔方(Gravity rubik's cube)
description:
Game introduction• Gravity Cube is a third-person action shooter game developed independently based on Unity engine. The scene structure is in a space where gravity is out of control. Players will play their roles in the game and fight with AI robots in the face of complex and changeable game scenes and constantly changing game mechanisms in the Cube

• Please note: this game is my immature first game, which means that there may be some bugs and functional design flaws in the game. At the time of making this game, my mastery of C# and Unity engine was not satisfactory, and I apologize for any inconvenience.
description_short: This FPS bullet screen shooting game combines gravity reversal effects, allowing players to control a character that can change gravity to overcome challenges.The game offers four modes. Please note that this is my first game and may have bugs and design flaws. Apologies for any inconvenience caused
